metadata.title: My Home
metadata.description:
One of the most common questions that I get asked often by the viewers is, where do I live?

I am from a small village in West Khasi Hills district of Meghalaya, situated in Eastern Himalayas.

The Eastern Himalayan Region hosts four biodiversity hotspots, and is home to many endemic species of flora and fauna.

Also, Out of India’s 427 ethnic communities, 200 communities call this region their home.  

The Balipara Foundation, launched in 2007, has been working to conserve this region and help the ethnic communities dependent on it by taking a community based approach.
